title: Question 27
passage:
Where do I tap my badge to unlock this test cabinet?
A. On the black reader next to the handle. B. The cabinet locks when you shut the door. C. The spare badges are in the top drawer.
passageZh:
我要在哪裡感應識別證，才能打開這個測試櫃？
A. 在把手旁邊的黑色感應器上。
B. 測試櫃的門一關上就會上鎖。
C. 備用識別證在最上層的抽屜裡。
